description:
FILED s448n (Opus round-6 agent N), while diagnosing #535.  PRE-EXISTING.  Same
family as #456 half (b) / #469 (the PHASE model across sections) -- a `package`
STATEMENT inside a bare block splits the block into sections, and the lexical
`let` is emitted per section instead of spanning the block.

REPRODUCER (perl prints all four lines; PCL dies on the first read of $p):

    my $Perl = "/bin/echo";
    {
        package p73626;
        sub TIESCALAR { bless {} }
        sub FETCH { "$Perl hi" }

        tie my $p, 'p73626';

        package main;

        print "tied:[$p]\n";
    }
        perl  tied:[/bin/echo hi]
        PCL   Unhandled unbound-variable: The variable $p is unbound.

The emitted CL is literally

    (let (($p (make-p-box nil))) (p-tie $p "p73626"))     ; one top-level form
    ...
    (p-print "tied:[" $p "]")                             ; another -- free $p

WITHOUT the captured file lexical ($Perl) in FETCH the same shape lowers
CORRECTLY, so the trigger is narrower than "a package switch in a block" --
find it before designing.

WHY IT MATTERS BEYOND THE CRASH: where a global cell for the name happens to
exist, the second form reads an EMPTY box instead of dying.  That is what
happens in perl's own t/io/open.t (the [perl#73626] block, line 376): the pipe
command comes out "" instead of the tied FETCH value, and PCL then took an empty
command for perl's BARE fork-open and forked -- so a second process ran the
whole rest of the file, racing its parent on the recovery loader's shared file
offset and truncating the run at a RANDOM form (measured: 118/3, 136/25 and
137/24 on the same tree).  The fork half is fixed (#535, s448n: a 3-arg open
with an empty command is now perl's error), so the file is deterministic again
and the row fails honestly -- but the lexical is still empty.

BAR: the reproducer above, plus the no-$Perl variant (which must keep working),
plus t/io/open.t's "open -| magic" row (perl 118).  A `Pl/**` change: generation
bump, corpus-diff, emission A/B over the four populations, and the full sweep.
subject: A `my` declared BEFORE an in-block `package NAME;` switch is not visible AFTER it -- the block is emitted as separate top-level forms and the `let` does not span them (crash, or an empty value where a global cell exists)
